parts.text: Please use our provided cord blood-derived CD34+ HSPCs and the Lenti/iNKT-CAR70-IL-15 viral vector to generate Allo CAR70-NKT cells, and subsequently perform the in vitro RCC tumor cell killing assay using our provided FG-labeled 786-O and ACHN target lines. Please carry out the protocol through all five stages—HSPC engineering, HSPC expansion, NKT differentiation, NKT deep differentiation, and NKT expansion—following the media formulations, Retronectin and StemSpan coating steps, centrifugation parameters, passage schedules, and cytokine supplementations as described in the source protocol. Specifically, transduce the HSPCs at an MOI of 100 on Retronectin-coated plates, expand them for 2 weeks using StemSpan SFEM II with Lymphoid Progenitor Expansion Supplement, drive differentiation using the Maturation Supplement and CD3/CD28/CD2 T Activator where indicated, and execute the final expansion using irradiated aAPCs (K562 cells overexpressing CD80, CD83, CD86, 4-1BBL, and CD70) at a 1:1 to 1:2 ratio supplemented with 10 ng/mL human IL-7 and IL-15. Please collect flow cytometry samples at the designated checkpoints to verify phenotype using antibodies for CD45, CD3, TCRαβ, 6B11, CAR70 (CD27), CD4, CD8, and eFluor 506 viability dye. Finally, perform the 24 to 48-hour co-culture cytotoxicity assay in 96-well clear-bottom black plates across E:T ratios of 0:1, 0.1:1, 0.5:1, 1:1, 2:1, 5:1, and 10:1 with four technical replicates per condition, normalized to the number of CAR+ cells, and quantify residual tumor cell viability by measuring luciferase activity after D-luciferin addition.
